name: Digitone II
summary: Experimental OS 1.12 support on the Modwerk Digitone II base (core 1.1). Voice Spread is the first module. Downloads stay disabled.

firmware.flash: Normal OS updates use Elektron Transfer with the owner's own stock OS file. The page builds Modwerk's Digitone II base alone from that file (beta); downloads stay disabled until the owner turns them on.
firmware.recovery: Hold FUNC while powering on, choose TRIG 4 (OS UPGRADE), then send the owner's stock .syx over MIDI DIN; recovery mode does not use USB. Checked on toonst's unit with stock 1.12 (23 October 2026, elekloader's build guide); on a second unit only the normal Transfer update back to stock 1.12 was tried (18 November 2026).

research.label: Digitone II OS research
research.note: OS 1.12: container, seal, staging, reset memory map, free DDR and SRAM, the seven core sites and the emulator checks. Stock-free: hashes and addresses only.

research.label: elekloader DTII core
research.note: The Digitakt II core whose events, sources and site patterns the Digitone II draft core reuses with OS 1.12's addresses.

research.label: core-dn2 0.3 (toonst's elekloader fork)
research.note: The Digitone II core with the Digitakt II 1.1 additions, input, SysEx and SHARC bridges. 0.1's UI events ran on toonst's unit; 0.3 booted and its six UI events ran on a second unit (18 November 2026). Its 1.1 additions and bridges are untested on hardware. Not copied into Modwerk yet.

research.label: Digitone II core on a unit, 18 November 2026
research.note: prodbysmolec's unit: stock 1.12 with core-dn2 0.3 and hello-marker, then hooks-check-dn2, built with toonst's elekloader at 3d7c2e3 and flashed with Transfer; boot, normal playback, all six UI events and the return to stock 1.12 observed.

sdk.toolchain: m68k-elf GCC and binutils and the pinned Elekloader kit with the device Modwerk's builder carries; builds start from the owner's exact OS 1.12 .syx.

budgets.name: Shared mod memory
budgets.note: Digitone II DDR region 0x47F00000–0x47F40000, shared by the base and linked mods.

budgets.name: Core image
budgets.note: Pinned Modwerk base: 3,656 bytes .run plus 3,120 bytes .bss. The linker measures each selected set.

budgets.name: Per-event subscriptions
budgets.note: The Modwerk base allocates four hook entries per shared event collection.
